I won't be covering pea-cocking in this thread)  - Confident Body Language (An alpha male is always relaxed and confident. Show that you're an alpha by using your body language.)  - Voice & Accents (Voice matters. If you have a weak and trembling voice... Go work on making it sound like Superman's voice, or Atticus Finch from "To Kill  A Mockingbird" shot around the 1960's. Also, I love using fake accents. Probably because the girls are really into how an asian has a british accent.   ) Other things:  - Keep in mind your body adapts to its surroudings. (EX: If you goto a club or bar and stand in the corner for the first five minutes, it'll be REALLY hard to get into Social Mode and talk to people)  - Brush your teeth and groom up before leaving. Fin.
